name: Acqualina Resort
positioning: Mediterranean-inspired oceanfront resort on Collins Avenue in Sunny Isles Beach, with a large spa, three pools and a complimentary kids program
best_for: Families who want a complimentary kids program and suites with full kitchens
Travelers who want a beach resort away from South Beach

facts.text: The resort is at 17875 Collins Avenue in Sunny Isles Beach, Florida.
Acqualina is a Mediterranean-inspired resort on the beach.
Miami designer Isabel Tragash and her team designed the guest rooms.
All guest rooms and suites have private balconies with views of the Atlantic Ocean or the Intracoastal Bay.
Every room and suite has a marble bathroom, Seed to Skin Tuscany amenities, high-speed Wi-Fi and an Illy espresso machine.
Many suites have full gourmet kitchens.
Ke-uH serves Japanese fusion cuisine at dinner, indoors and outdoors.
The beachside Costa Grill is reserved for hotel guests, residents and Beach Club members.
Spa guests can use a crystal steam room, sauna, Himalayan salt lounges and an outdoor spa terrace with a heated jet pool and Roman waterfall.
The resort has three outdoor swimming pools; the oceanfront Adult Pool is for guests 18 and over.
The Recreational Pool hosts staff-led pool games, activities and aqua fitness classes.
The resort is close to Bal Harbour Shops and Aventura Mall.

highlights.text: The marine-themed AcquaMarine program is complimentary for children ages 4 to 12, with lunch available at a cost.
Acqualina Spa is a 20,000-square-foot, two-story spa with eleven treatment rooms and a private spa suite for two.
Beach service for hotel guests includes complimentary umbrellas, chaise lounges, towels and beach butler service.
Guests reach Avra Miami, which serves Greek cuisine, by a short walk across a sky bridge.
The resort offers a private 5.5-hour Everglades National Park tour with naturalists from Wild Lime Adventures.

considerations.text: Conde Nast Traveler's reviewer noted the resort is a 30 to 40 minute drive from South Beach.
AcquaMarine camp reservations are required at least 24 hours in advance.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the resort's ultra-luxury positioning.
